name: Piano Fundamentals
description: A foundation course covering posture, keyboard familiarity, basic notation, rhythm, and introductory repertoire.

name: Teen Piano Foundations
description: An introduction to piano designed around developing confidence, technique, and musical understanding.

name: Adult Piano Foundations
description: A flexible introduction to piano for adults beginning their musical journey.

name: Intermediate Piano
description: Develop technique, musical interpretation, sight reading, and repertoire beyond the beginner level.

name: Advanced Piano
description: Focused instruction for advanced students working toward challenging repertoire and stronger performance skills.

name: Ear Training
description: Develop the ability to recognize intervals, chords, melodies, rhythms, and musical patterns by ear.

name: Music Theory
description: Explore notation, scales, chords, harmony, key signatures, and the principles behind the music you play.

name: Sight Reading
description: Build confidence reading unfamiliar music and translating notation into accurate musical performance.

name: Chord Progressions
description: Learn common chord patterns and how they can be used for accompaniment, songwriting, and improvisation.

name: Piano Improvisation
description: Explore improvisation through scales, chords, patterns, musical ideas, and creative experimentation.

name: Songwriting at the Piano
description: Use piano skills as a foundation for developing melodies, chord progressions, lyrics, and complete songs.

name: Performance Preparation
description: Prepare for recitals, concerts, examinations, auditions, and other public performances.

name: Exam Preparation
description: Structured preparation for practical music examinations with emphasis on repertoire, technique, and musicianship.

name: Pop Piano
description: Learn practical piano skills for playing contemporary songs, chord patterns, melodies, and accompaniment.

name: Gospel Piano
description: Develop gospel-oriented accompaniment skills including chord voicings, progressions, fills, and musical expression.

name: Accompaniment Skills
description: Learn how to support singers and ensembles through effective accompaniment, listening, and musical communication.

name: Musicality & Expression
description: Refine phrasing, dynamics, articulation, interpretation, and expressive performance.

name: Audition Coaching
description: Individual preparation for auditions with attention to repertoire, performance confidence, musical interpretation, and presentation.
